mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions and economic expansion, which typically leads to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and economic weakness, which typically triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a deepening economic contraction, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profitability and risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 5.0%), higher interest rates compress equity valuations and increase borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which typically supports corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and reducing equity valuations, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to falling corporate revenues and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery (UNRATE falling below 4.0% and PAYEMS rising), improved employment conditions boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0% and PAYEMS is rising.
